pages.title: Steel Tools
pages.text: Steel tools are the best tools in SteamCraft. They have $(bold)500 durability$() and a good enchantability of $(bold)20$(). They are made by upgrading iron tools at a $(bold)Smithing Table$() using a $(bold)Steel Ingot$() as the upgrade material.

pages.title: How to Upgrade
pages.text: Open the Smithing Table. Place your $(bold)Iron Tool$() in the first slot, a $(bold)Steel Ingot$() template in the middle, and confirm. The result is the steel version of that tool. You can upgrade the pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, and sword.

pages.title: Steel Pickaxe
pages.text: 500 durability, 5.0 mining speed, enchantability 20. Upgrade from any iron pickaxe.

pages.title: Tip
pages.text: Steel tools mine at the same speed as diamond but last longer than iron. They are a great middle-ground before you have full diamond gear. Don't forget to recycle broken steel tools in the $(bold)Recycler$() — you'll get a Steel Ingot back (with 70% success).
